dct_description_sm: This layer delineates the actual public sidewalks using polygon geometries. It includes attribute information about the material types used in sidewalk construction, such as concrete, brick, gravel, and wood. While some private sidewalks may appear in the dataset, efforts are ongoing to remove unauthorized entries during updates. Park paths are excluded as they are represented in separate datasets.
